paper_title: The Grenoble Axion Haloscope platform (GrAHal): development plan and first results
notes: First pathfinder run of GrAHal sets a single exclusion point g_agamma <= 2.2e-13 GeV^-1 (22x KSVZ) at 6.375 GHz (m_a = 26.37 ueV) at 95% CL, assuming axions constitute all local DM.
